info.title: Microsoft 365 Calendar Universal API
info.description: Access Microsoft 365 calendar data through Microsoft Graph, including calendars, events, and calendar views for the signed-in user.

put.description: Accepts an event invitation in Microsoft 365 Calendar.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

eventId.description: The ID of the Outlook event to accept.

comment.description: Optional comment to include with the accept response.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

post.description: Creates a new event in Microsoft 365 Calendar.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

start.dateTime.description: Event start date and time in ISO format. Use UTC values such as 2026-03-19T15:00:00.

end.dateTime.description: Event end date and time in ISO format. Use UTC values such as 2026-03-19T15:30:00.

bodyPreview.description: Plain-text preview of the event body.

isAllDay.description: Whether the event lasts all day.

webLink.description: Outlook web URL for the event.
